short_description:
Where to sell stolen cars in GTA 6: Moses in Port Gellhorn (Kelly County) buys cars without a tracker once you've done his Chapter 2 job. He won't take cars stolen right next to his garage, and damage lowers the price. High-end cars with trackers go to Randy later in the story (Chapter 3 in most guides). Payouts in guides vary a lot: check the offer in-game. No story spoilers.

Sources: PC Gamer, KeenGamer, GTABase, timesaver.gg.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).
